image_rows.quatsinoporites: Row 1 has irregular margins and genuine depth cavities; side thickness and top pore count conflict. Use original broken boundary and 40-ish varied blind openings, no full cap. Pore relief deliberately enlarged; not microscopic tissue replication.
image_rows.nidula-baltica: Row 2 is much too broad compared with author description of narrowly obconic vase. Resolve to narrow high cup, one small lenticular body, restrained overlapping rim scales; unseen outer wall is simplified artistic interpolation. Corrected figures 1–2 AF-9-20B remain authority; figure 3 excluded. Corrected full figure pixels could not be retrieved, so specimen-specific conformity remains unknown.
image_rows.cave-column: Row 3 consistent continuous pillar; attachment outlines vary across views. Author one continuous fluted volume with limited broad patches at floor and ceiling, irregular lower accumulation and narrow fused middle.
image_rows.rusophycus-resting-excavation: Row 4 shows clearly concave paired lobes; top and cutaway septum differ. Author two short deeply excavated depressions with recessed oblique scratches and a central low dividing ridge; no raised cast, no cutaway copied from concept.
